metas.name: The Storyteller
metas.description: The Storyteller, aided by his cynical dog, narrates classic folk tales, fables, and legends.

metas.name: Horrible Histories
metas.description: Based on the best-selling children's books and liberally splattered with guts, blood and poo, a group of British comedians offer an anarchic and unconventional take on some of history's most gruesome and funny moments, with topics including the Stone Age, the Middle Ages, the Egyptians and the Romans, among others.

metas.name: Paddington 2
metas.description: Paddington, now happily settled with the Browns, picks up a series of odd jobs to buy the perfect present for his Aunt Lucy, but it is stolen.

metas.name: The Muppet Show
metas.description: Go behind the curtains as Kermit the Frog and his muppet friends struggle to put on a weekly variety show.

metas.name: Oliver!
metas.description: Musical adaptation of Charles Dickens' Oliver Twist, a classic tale of an orphan who runs away from the workhouse and joins up with a group of boys headed by the Artful Dodger and trained to be pickpockets by master thief Fagin.

metas.name: Labyrinth
metas.description: Frustrated with babysitting on yet another weekend night, Sarah, a teenager with an active imagination, summons the Goblins to take her baby stepbrother away. When little Toby actually disappears, Sarah must follow him into a fantastical world to rescue him from the Goblin King. Guarding his castle is the labyrinth itself, a twisted maze of deception, populated with outrageous characters and unknown dangers.

metas.name: Paddington
metas.description: A young Peruvian bear travels to London in search of a home. Finding himself lost and alone at Paddington Station, he meets the kindly Brown family, who offer him a temporary haven.

metas.name: The Sheep Detectives
metas.description: George Hardy is a shepherd who reads detective novels to his beloved sheep every night, assuming they can't possibly understand. But when a mysterious incident disrupts life on the farm, the sheep realize they must become the detectives. As they follow the clues and investigate human suspects, they prove that even sheep can be brilliant crime-solvers.

metas.name: A Street Cat Named Bob
metas.description: James Bowen, a homeless busker and recovering drug addict, has his life transformed when he meets a stray ginger cat.

metas.name: The Dark Crystal
metas.description: On another planet in the distant past, a Gelfling embarks on a quest to find the missing shard of a magical crystal and restore order to his world, before the grotesque race of Skeksis find and use the crystal for evil.

metas.name: Goodbye Christopher Robin
metas.description: The behind the scenes story of the life of A.A. Milne and the creation of the Winnie the Pooh stories inspired by his son Christopher Robin.

metas.name: Chitty Chitty Bang Bang
metas.description: A hapless inventor finally finds success with a flying car, which a dictator from a foreign government sets out to take for himself.

metas.name: Roald Dahl's Matilda the Musical
metas.description: An extraordinary young girl discovers her superpower and summons the remarkable courage, against all odds, to help others change their stories, whilst also taking charge of her own destiny. Standing up for what's right, she's met with miraculous results.

metas.name: Arabian Nights
metas.description: Targeted for assassination by his first wife and his evil brother, a young sultan must marry by the next full moon or he will lose his kingdom. His uncertainty over his newfound bride causes her to stall the sultan with a series of fantastic stories to ease the tension and stall her impending execution.

metas.name: House of Anubis
metas.description: Strange things are happening at an English boarding school called House of Anubis. Popular student Joy goes missing, the school's cranky caretaker has a creepy stuffed crow and the school's attic may be haunted. When recent American transplant Nina gets thrust into the school during this time, she decides to investigate along with her new friend, Fabian, and housemates.
